construction.note: Native x64 qualification requires fresh build, original upstream tests, complete consumed-framework byte comparisons, actual source delivery and three native user spaces. No AArch64 result or historical archive hash qualifies x64. Bootstrap and other upstream binary inputs remain in scope.
